name: Mórrígna
text: Mórrígna, with the spelling Mórrigna, is an Irish name meaning great queens. It labels the trio of war-goddesses usually given as Badb, Macha, and Mórrígan. Nemain sometimes takes a place in the list, whether as a double for Badb or for Mórrígan or as her substitute. Some commentators go further and read Mórrígna as identical with Mórrígan alone, with Badb, Macha, and Nemain as her separate aspects.

okr.objective: Documents Mórrígna as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Mórrígna means great queens and names a trio of war-goddesses.
The usual trio is Badb, Macha, and Mórrígan, with Nemain at times added.
Some commentators make the trio one goddess, Mórrígan, in three aspects.
